title: Partner catalog activation: copy lint, security gates, and preflight checklist
body:
Purpose and scope:
This is a compact working playbook for activating partner listings across cloud marketplaces (AWS/Azure/GCP) and publisher shelves. Focus: 1) clean, conversion-oriented copy and microcopy linting, 2) technical & security acceptance gates, 3) preflight asset checklist and quick rollback triggers.

Notes to self (context):
- This doc is intentionally granular so SEs and Partner Ops can tick boxes quickly during handoffs.
- Audience: partner success, partner-facing PMs, listing owners, growth ops.
- Keep the short tile and one-liner consistent across channels; vendors often paste different variations which breaks standing ads.

1) Listing copy matrix (short -> long -> benefit bullets -> CTA)
- Tile (8–12 words): concise problem + signal of scale "High-throughput LLM inference for production apps" (example).
- One-liner (12–25 words): target persona + value + CTA "Engineers and platform teams get predictable latency and cost for LLM workloads — try with a free trial or request a demo."
- Long description (200–450 words): product overview, deployment modes (hosted/dedicated/private), technical differentiators (runtime, caching, smart routing), sample use cases, short customer quote placeholder.
- 3 benefit bullets (15–30 words each): measurable impact e.g., "Reduce per-token cost by up to X% via smart batching and caching". Avoid generic "scalable" without a qualifier.
- CTA variants (choose 1): "Start free trial" | "Request demo" | "Get pricing". Map CTA to listing SKU visibility (free trial visible on trial-enabled SKUs only).

Copy lint checklist (quick):
- No passive voice in tile or one-liner.
- Avoid jargon: explain "dedicated capacity" in consumer-facing short copy (eg "reserved GPU pools").
- Use active verbs for CTAs.
- Remove internal product names (console-internal IDs) from public copy.
- Check for trademark mentions and vendor/product names policy per marketplace.
- Accessibility: alt text templates for screenshots included in assets.

2) Asset & creative preflight
- Logos: SVG + 2x PNG, transparent background, min 500 px width.
- Screenshots: 3 landscape screenshots (1280x720) with annotations removed, captions as separate text file.
- 1 explainer video (30–60s) optional, MP4 H.264 under 50MB.
- Privacy / data handling blurb: 1-paragraph (50–80 words) that explains telemetry collection and KMS/HSM usage if applicable.
- Support contact: support@redwood.com and partner-success@redwood.com as primary contact strings.

3) Technical acceptance gates (hard):
- Billing SKUs: mapped and validated in marketplace portal (SKU IDs recorded in GTMP-482).
- SSO/OAuth: publisher SSO flows tested (if listing links into a console experience). Record test account credentials in secure vault.
- VPC & private deployment listing: confirm wording for "on-prem" vs "private VPC" to avoid implying managed infra.
- Model & data residency statements: explicit region list if Private offering.
- Security posture: SOC2/ISO27001 attestation docs attached or link to SOC2 summary. If not available, add a mitigation note and timeline.
- Pen test: results or attestation must be referenced for any partner feature that will route customer data through Redwood-managed endpoints.

4) Soft technical checks (recommended):
- Performance SLO note: typical 95th latency numbers for 1k-token prefix vs max-seqlen. Use model profile from model-catalog sheet.
- Runtime compatibility note: which quantized model variants we support for the SKU (eg gpt-*-q8) — avoids surprises with marketplace customers expecting full fp16.
- Endpoint fallback routes: ensure listing copy doesn’t promise a single region-only SLA unless backed by Dedicated commit.

5) Legal & compliance quick blocks
- Data processing addendum required? (yes/no) — if yes, include link to template.
- KMS/HSM: mention availability and how keys are stored during Private deployments.
- PII/PCI firewall: state if the listing precludes payment card data processing.
- Terms copy: include standard legal blurb snippet and confirm marketplace-specific terms (AWS/Azure/GCP) are appended.

6) Launch ops checklist (pre-publish):
- Asset bucket versioned and labeled (assets/v{version}/).
- SKU mapping validated in billing and product catalog.
- CTA mapping verified: trial vs demo routing.
- E2E test (deploy listing as draft, run sign-up flow with test customer account, exercise trial provisioning).
- Monitoring hooks: ensure trial conversion event emits to analytics (events: marketplace_signup, trial_started, trial_converted).
- Add short-lived feature flag to enable immediate rollback if provisioning fails.

7) Rollback and incident triggers (quick rules):
- Immediate rollback if >5% signup failures in first 24h or >2 production incidents linked to listing signups.
- Manual rollback criteria: partner-reported data leak, billing mismatch >2% of invoice volume.
- Communication play: prepare message template for partners and customers (see templates below).

8) Communication templates (copy snippets)
- Partner notification subject: "Redwood listing activation: next steps + audit checklist"
- Customer-facing banner (short): "Now available via [Marketplace] — start a free trial or contact sales for Dedicated capacity."
- Support escalation line: "If provisioning fails, open GTMP-482 and tag @partner-ops; escalation: oncall-sre -> partner-ops -> partner-success."

9) Example copy options (editable placeholders):
- Tile: "Redwood Inference — predictable, low-latency LLM serving"
- One-liner: "Ship LLM features faster with a runtime that guarantees latency and reduces token costs for production apps."
- 3 benefits: 
  • "Hosted API for fast time-to-value; Dedicated pools for predictable throughput."
  • "Automatic caching and batching to cut per-token cost without sacrificing latency."
  • "Private deployment options for regulated workloads with KMS support.
- CTA: "Start free trial" (trial-enabled SKU)

10) Open questions / unresolved items
- Pricing copy: should we call out estimated $/1k tokens for the marketplace tile? (legal is wary — propose: use a "starts at" sample only on pricing page, not tile).
- Trial eligibility: restrict to new customers? how to detect returning trial takers across portals?
- Logo variants: need partner logo approval from brand team (Lina) before publish.

11) Owners & action items (quick):
- Copy finalization: Ava T. (owner) — draft due +3 days after PR comment round.
- Technical acceptance sign-off: Sam C. — confirm SSO/billing/test flow.
- Asset upload & labeling: Diego M. — ensure naming conventions.
- Legal/compliance: Priya K. — SOC2 statement and DPA link.

12) Quick publishing timeline (example sprint):
- Day 0: copy + assets ready, draft submitted to marketplace portal.
- Day 1–2: marketplace validation, respond to compliance questions.
- Day 3–5: internal e2e test, sign-off.
- Day 5: publish and monitor first 48h closely for anomalies.

Appendix: links & references
- Marketplace brand guidelines (internal link): confluence:marketplace-brand-guidelines
- Billing SKU mapping sheet: spreadsheet:GTM-billing-SKUs
- PR template for asset updates: github:marketplace-assets/PR-template

Quick reminder (tone): keep external copy benefits-first, avoid overselling numerical claims unless we have an internal benchmark doc to cite. If in doubt, lean on "reduces cost and improves predictability" rather than hard % numbers.

End of doc — use as a living checklist.

Unresolved JIRA tickets to add to this doc on next pass: GTMP-512 (trial routing edge-case), GTMP-537 (logo approval queue integration).
